articles.title: Dollar-backed stablecoins can push local currencies lower, Bank of Korea study finds
articles.snippet: Buying pressure in Binance-paired currencies correlates with local currency depreciation as market makers balance positions.

articles.title: Fomo overtakes Pump.fun in daily revenue on Solana
articles.snippet: Fomo generated $1.76 million on Friday, beating Pump.fun’s $1.1 million, though the memecoin launchpad remains ahead over 30 days.

articles.title: ‘White hats’ take 4000 BTC from Liquid, ETFs see best inflows of 2026: Hodler’s Digest
articles.snippet: Purported white hat hackers have taken 4000 Bitcoin from the Liquid sidechain in a major security breach. The Bitcoin ETFs see the best three weeks of inflows in 2026.

articles.title: Satoshi-era Bitcoin wakes after 16 years of dormancy as 600 BTC moves
articles.snippet: Whale Alert identified 12 mining rewards totaling 600 BTC that moved after 16 years of dormancy, with the onchain tracking platform finding no connection to Satoshi Nakamoto.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.
